newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton rebounds on short covering, ends up.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton rebounds on short covering, ends up.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed a see-saw session firmer as speculators covered short positions in late dealings.
Floor sources said prices were due for a correction after three consecutive days of weakness. "Today's close signals we are oversold technically and are going to bounce to 73.00," a dealer said.

In the next several weeks, however, the December contract is expected to fall below its contract low of 70.50 and into the 60.00-cent a lb range, based on a hearty crop that appears to be in good condition.
Industry sources await today's U.S. Department of Agriculture's crop condition report, released after the close.
December ended 0.27 firmer at 71.92, having ranged from 72.40 to 71.15. The back months closed 0.08 to 0.45 higher.
